title: LabelChangePlan
description: The communications plan of a scheduled label change (data layer phase 6b). The server builds it from the evaluation when a steward approves a change for a date. The steward reads it and approves it. Nothing is sent before then. It holds counts, wording and dates, never a person's address and never a record value.

notice_days.description: Whole days from the day the change was scheduled to the effective date.

notice_days_min.description: The shortest notice settings allow for this change. notice_days is never less.

change.description: What changes, as category ids from settings. It names no row and no value.

timeline.description: Dates are days before the effective date. Reminders, a final warning and a confirmation are not built yet, so the timeline holds the first notice and the day.

channels.description: inbox and email follow each person's preferences, and the inbox always receives it. api is the upcoming_changes block on a read of the dataset's records.

count.description: How many people the audience holds when the plan is built.

told.description: What the audience is told, in plain words. It holds no record value.
